title: Company Dashboard Hub Deck
brands: Smart Upkeep brand: white and warm cream, terracotta, lagoon and jungle accents, Khand and Hind, light mode only, no emoji.
request: Max Oct 17 2026 21:11 ICT: "can you push a deck for the upkeep company dashboard"; 21:17 ICT: "can we set up the company dashboard the same way [main dashboard then agent dashboards]. we will eventually have agents that are in charge of each section"; 21:23-21:24 ICT: UpKeep owner dashboard that looks like Max's own dashboard (Apps Home) with an org chart and an order of operations; new agents shown as placeholders; Grok Bot 2 is UpKeep's chief, reporting to Grok Bot
applies_to: Smart Upkeep company dashboard (not the member app, tech app or Operator Console)
example_data: Every name, number and date is example data.
source_note: No built company dashboard found; picks based on UpKeep notes and docs plus Max 21:17 ICT: two-level hub (like Apps Home -> agent boards) with a section dashboard per future agent; 21:23-21:24 ICT: final org from UpKeep (Max > Grok Bot > Grok Bot 2, 10 sections, shared Security/Branding/Legal), Org Chart picks drawn in the Apps Home org chart style.

pairs.ask: Company Hub: Hub card style, a grid of section tiles like Apps Home, or one row per section in a tight list?

optionA.label: Section Tile Grid
optionA.desc: Tiles like Apps Home, tap to open
